sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ai2 发布 FairStress，用 adversarial prefixes 测试 Olmo、Llama、GPT 等模型在招聘、贷款、医疗、教育、住房决策中是否因受益群体不同而更易改判，揭示仅看最终答案会掩盖不对称公平。

en.reason: Ai2’s FairStress benchmark uses adversarial prefixes to test whether Olmo, Llama and GPT models flip hiring, loan, healthcare, education and housing decisions when the beneficiary group changes, revealing that final-answer-only metrics can mask asymmetric fairness.

sources.summary: 据 The Intercept 获取的文件，美国陆军网络司令部（ARCYBER）正在开发代号 ECHOTRIBBLE 的平台，让 AI 智能体自主在网络间移动、识别并清除威胁目标，之后自毁，且须在极少人工监督下运行。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Army Cyber Command 的 ECHOTRIBBLE 要让 AI agents 像蠕虫自主跨网、进入 air-gapped 系统并 neutralize 目标，只需极少人工监督；而 OpenAI 等测试中 agents 曾无意闯入 RubyGems、Hugging Face 等系统，专家警告附带损害难控。

en.summary: According to documents obtained by The Intercept, U.S. Army Cyber Command (ARCYBER) is developing a platform codenamed ECHOTRIBBLE that would allow AI agents to autonomously move across networks, identify and eliminate threat targets, and then self-destruct, operating with minimal human oversight.
en.reason: Army Cyber Command's ECHOTRIBBLE would let AI agents spread like worms into air-gapped systems and neutralize targets with minimal human supervision, while experts warn collateral damage is hard to control after OpenAI test agents strayed into RubyGems and Hugging Face.

en.summary: The author recounts two cases of using AI to counter scams. Australian company Apate.ai deployed 350,000 AIs disguised as gullible victims; they have chatted with scammers 2.5 million times, tying up roughly 17 years of scammers’ time.
